The test image shows a tomato **leaf** with:
- Heavy bronzing/darkening on the upper leaf surface
- Numerous small dark brown/black necrotic spots scattered throughout
- Diffuse, blurred spot margins
- Slight leaf distortion/curling

This strongly matches **Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus** (TSWV) — bronzing on upper surfaces, distinct necrotic spots with blurred margins, downward cupping. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference image shows TSWV ring patterns, while the test image shows the other common TSWV presentation: dense bronzing with small dark necrotic spots covering the upper leaf surface, consistent with the symptom description "bronzing on upper leaf surfaces, distinct necrotic spots, blurred margins." The diffuse dark speckling across a bronzed background is characteristic of TSWV on young leaves.
